source.title: Virtual Cell Challenge 2025 dataset (H1 hESC, CRISPRi, 10x Flex)
source.citation: Arc Institute, Virtual Cell Challenge 2025. Cell 188 (2025).
source.why_this_project: Only public corpus sharing this year's chemistry (10x Flex), CRISPRi modality and high-knockdown target selection. Highest per-byte value.
source.caveat: Median depth ~53k UMI/cell vs 20k in the 2026 evaluation - must be downsampled before use in mock rounds.
